newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BABBEL GETS DEADLINE ON MAN UTD OFFER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BABBEL GETS DEADLINE ON MAN UTD OFFER.

text.p: Bayern Munich defender Markus Babbel has been told to make up his mind by Monday whether to accept an offer to join English premier league champions Manchester United, Bayern said on Thursday.
"Manchester is keeping its offer open until Monday -- and we want to know one way or the other by then too," Bayern manager Uli Hoeness told reporters.

Babbel said earlier this week Manchester's existing offer was not high enough. German media have reported he wants a salary of four million marks ($2.3 million) per year over three years while Manchester was offering 1.75 million marks per year.
Babbel headed off on holiday on Tuesday, with negotiations continuing through his lawyer. A transfer fee of 14 million marks ($8.05 million) has already been agreed, Hoeness said earlier this week.
